Shai Gilgeous-Alexander becomes the sixth player since 2000 to record back-to-back 40+ PTS games against the same opponent, joining:
Stephen Curry vs. Spurs (2025)
Nikola Jokić vs. Spurs (2024)
Luka Dončić vs. Clippers (2021)
Russell Westbrook vs. Pelicans (2014)
Kobe Bryant vs. Nuggets (2002)
